Kubernetes baseline.title: Containers must run as non-root
Kubernetes baseline.description: Workloads must set a non-root user or security context.
Kubernetes baseline.remediation: Set runAsNonRoot and runAsUser in the pod or container security context.

mappings.azure_policy: Kubernetes cluster containers should run with a non-root user
mappings.tanzu: Tanzu Application Platform restricted pod security

Kubernetes baseline.title: Resource requests and limits required
Kubernetes baseline.description: Pods must declare CPU and memory requests and limits.
Kubernetes baseline.remediation: Add resource requests and limits to every application container.

mappings.azure_policy: Kubernetes cluster containers CPU and memory resource limits should not exceed limits

Kubernetes baseline.title: Liveness and readiness probes required
Kubernetes baseline.description: Services need health probes so operations can detect broken rollouts.
Kubernetes baseline.remediation: Add livenessProbe and readinessProbe to deployment manifests.

Container security.title: Privileged containers denied
Container security.description: Privileged pods are blocked unless an approved exception exists.
Container security.remediation: Remove privileged mode or attach a documented exception approved by platform security.

mappings.azure_policy: Kubernetes cluster privileged containers should be avoided

Container security.title: hostPath volumes restricted
Container security.description: hostPath mounts are restricted to prevent node escape paths.
Container security.remediation: Replace hostPath usage with a persistent volume or approved CSI driver.

mappings.azure_policy: Kubernetes cluster pod hostPath volume mounts should not be used

Container security.title: Approved image registries required
Container security.description: Images must come from approved and scanned registries.
Container security.remediation: Move images to the approved registry and attach scan evidence.

Workload identity.title: Workload identity configuration required
Workload identity.description: Cloud access must use workload identity rather than static credentials.
Workload identity.remediation: Configure managed identity, IRSA, Workload Identity, or platform equivalent.

Network policy.title: Network policies required
Network policy.description: Namespaces must include ingress and egress network policies.
Network policy.remediation: Apply baseline deny-by-default policies and explicit service dependency rules.

mappings.azure_policy: Kubernetes cluster namespaces should use network policies

Secrets management.title: Required secret management pattern
Secrets management.description: Secrets must be sourced from an approved vault or external secret operator.
Secrets management.remediation: Use external secrets with the cloud or enterprise vault integration.

mappings.azure_policy: Key Vault and CSI driver initiative

Audit logging.title: Audit logging required
Audit logging.description: Regulated environments must emit audit logs to a retained evidence store.
Audit logging.remediation: Enable platform audit logging, retention, and dashboard evidence before go-live.

mappings.azure_policy: AKS diagnostic settings should be enabled

Data platform hardening.title: Persistent storage class required
Data platform hardening.description: Stateful workloads must use an approved storage class.
Data platform hardening.remediation: Set storageClassName to the approved encrypted storage class.

Data platform hardening.title: Backup policy required for data-heavy systems
Data platform hardening.description: Kafka, OpenSearch, and database-heavy workloads require backup and recovery evidence.
Data platform hardening.remediation: Attach backup policy, restore test, and retention evidence to the environment profile.

Regulated environment controls.title: Change evidence required for regulated environments
Regulated environment controls.description: Regulated go-live requires evidence for policy, drift, audit, and support handover.
Regulated environment controls.remediation: Generate the regulated go-live evidence pack before production approval.
